en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a grand neoclassical colonnade along a canal or river. Crowds of people stroll under the long arcade and along the waterfront promenade, while early 20th‑century cars and buses line the adjacent street. Behind the colonnade rise tree‑covered slopes and several multi‑storey spa or hotel buildings. The text at the bottom left reads "Karlsbad. Mühlbrunnkolonnade".
